newsitem.title: USA: CSCE coffee ends higher, but resistance intact.
newsitem.headline: CSCE coffee ends higher, but resistance intact.

text.p: CSCE coffee prices strengthened on Tuesday amid what analysts said was an increasingly favorable technical picture, but the benchmark December contract stopped short of key chart resistance.
"Technically, the panorama is looking better," said Hencorp Becstone president Victor Henriquez. "The market wants to pick up."

While the eventual onslaught of new-crop coffee from Central and South America poins to lower prices in the long-term, prompt supplies are still under strain, he said, preventing the "C" contract from tumbling through 100.00-cent- per-lb mark. Steady buying from U.S. and European roasters (processors) on the dips has underpinned the market in recent days, he added.

December delivery rose 1.45 cent per lb on the day, to 106 cents, having traded from 104.90-106.50. After peaking early in the session, prices spent much of the session near unchanged. A late rally lifted prices back near the highs, but left unfilled a gap created at the opening at 106.00-106.50.
Second-month March gained 1.25, to settle at 102.70, while the remaining months climbed 1.10 to 1.55.
The day's volume was moderate, at an estimated 6,600 lots.

Meanwhile, dealers continued to monitor events in London, where key producer and consumer representatives were holding talks this week. Several said prices were unlikely to break sharply in either direction until the conclusion of a gathering of the Association of Coffee Producing Countries (ACPC), slated for this Saturday.
While there was no sign the ACPC, a 14-member producers' cartel, was gearing up for a major policy change, traders remained wary of any modification to the group's current export scheme.
On the charts, December would need to punch through the widely-watched 106.50-107.25 area to confirm a more bullish trend. To the downside, 102.75 and 101.50 were key support levels.
-- Wendy Pollack, New York Commodities Desk +1 212 859 1640
